info.description: Airline directory entries — identifiers, base of operations, contact info

shortDescription.description: 1-2 sentence tagline shown directly under the airline name in the hero.

keyDestinations.description: AI-generated list of the airline's real notable destinations (array of city strings), used to render a routes section and destination FAQs when no tracked routes exist. Empty when the airline is too obscure to state confidently.

faqs.description: AI-generated FAQ set (array of { q, a }) rendered in the airline page's FAQ section. Regenerated by enrich-airlines.js.

frequentFlyerProgram.description: Name of the airline's loyalty / frequent-flyer programme (e.g. 'Velocity Frequent Flyer'). Empty when the airline has none or it is unknown.

frequentFlyerUrl.description: Official URL of the frequent-flyer programme. Empty when unknown.

goodToKnow.description: AI-generated 'Good to know' cards (array of { title, body }, at least 4) rendered in the airline page's 'Flying with X — what to expect' section.
